definition: Operations that find data products in catalogues and retrieve their data: selecting products by area, time and metadata, and retrieving bands or areas of a product, without computing new quantities from them -- independent of any input/output signature or implementation (OGC 14-065 WPS 2.0.2 §7.5.1).

hasAction.description: The object identifier of this item moves from https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/concept/data-discovery-and-access to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/concept/data-discovery-and-access, which resolves through w3id.org (decision of 2026-11-17); the register actions of the item move with it, under https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/concept/data-discovery-and-access/actions/. The old IRI is kept as owl:sameAs. The content of the item is unchanged. Classified clarifying: the item is the same, only its identifier changes.
